verdicts.verify_by: grep -n 'RenderRealm(' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/handler_http.go (903 and 1063 discard the meta); benchmark GetRealmView on a community realm whose lead is 20k emphasis spans, with and without the md.Lead call
verdicts.tldr: Every render pays the Lead walk, though the user page, the README view and every community page throw its result away
verdicts.details: RenderRealm always calls md.Lead (render.go:151). handler_http.go:903 and :1063 discard the returned meta. setHead clears the lead whenever mayRepeat is false (handler_http.go:1484-1486), and mayRepeat is true only for official or operator pages with no args and no query (page_kind.go:143-144), so on every community view the lead is computed and dropped. The cost is bounded by the first paragraph and the 1 MiB render cap, so this is a performance tradeoff, not a bug. Fix: compute the lead only when the caller will use it, e.g. a flag in RealmRenderContext or a separate Lead call in the two handlers that read meta.

verdicts.details: scalarValue (alias_static.go:106-126) trims, joins, and strips only one wrapping pair of matching quotes. Of the three shapes round 2 named, the head fixes only the wrapping pair. Fix: cut an unquoted value at the first ' #', and replace '' with ' after removing single quotes.

verdicts.verify_by: cp 2-fedfdde13/tests/b2-lines-removed-reach-catalog-lead-bufio-alloc.go gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/zz_lead_alloc_test.go && go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown -run TestLeadAllocVsRender -v -count=1: the emphasis, links and code-span rows sit at 0.2x-0.6x, the plain rows at 6.6x and 11.3x
verdicts.tldr: A long plain first paragraph costs several times the memory of rendering the page, all to keep 160 runes
verdicts.details: Lead builds the whole paragraph's text (visibleText, then oneLine's Map, Fields and Join). It then converts the result to []rune twice: once at line 55 for the 40-rune minimum check, and again in truncateRunes (line 161), all to keep 160 runes. On a large plain paragraph this costs several full copies plus two 4-byte-per-rune slices. The 1 MiB render cap bounds it and only memory grows, so this is polish. The 11.3x ratio is the finder's number; this judge did not run it. Fix: use utf8.RuneCountInString for the minimum check, and stop collecting text once descriptionMaxRunes+1 runes are kept.

verdicts.verify_by: Lead on the three sources above with the production goldmark options: expect description "", observe the trailing paragraph
verdicts.tldr: A trusted page's summary can come from a paragraph after a list, a quote or a table, which the godoc says never happens
verdicts.details: The loop at description.go:50-59 ends the lead only on a top-level KindHeading or KindThematicBreak. It skips every other kind, including List, Blockquote and Table, and takes the next paragraph of 40+ runes. A heading nested inside a blockquote or a list item is not top level, so it does not stop the walk either. The godoc at lines 38-39 says text belonging to 'a list or a post someone else wrote' never names the page. Only trusted pages reach the head through mayRepeat, which limits the exposure. Fix: also end the lead at a top-level List, Blockquote or Table, or narrow the godoc.

verdicts.verify_by: go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB5_CanonicalOriginEmptyHost -v -count=1 with the artifact copied in
verdicts.tldr: -canonical-origin https://:8443 is accepted, so every canonical and og:url names a hostless origin
verdicts.details: For 'https://:8443', u.Host is ':8443'. The host == "" check tests that host:port string, not u.Hostname(), so it passes. TrimSuffix(':443') does not match, strayColon is false because Hostname() is empty, port 8443 is in range, and the round-trip String() equals the input, so the origin comes back unchanged. For 'https://gno.land:0443', Atoi reads 443 as valid, and TrimSuffix(':443') does not strip ':0443'. An operator typo yields broken canonicals with no startup error. Fix: test u.Hostname() == "", and compare the parsed port number to the default port.
